set -euo pipefail
source=/g/JiBuildCache/ji-host-0.1.3-linux-x64-java21.tar.gz
raw=/g/JiBuildCache/ji-host-0.1.6-failed-health.tar
archive=${raw}.gz
fixture=/g/JiBuildCache/stage4-failed-health-launcher-0.1.6
rm -rf "$fixture" "$raw" "$archive"
mkdir -p "$fixture/ji-host/bin"
gzip -dc "$source" > "$raw"
tar --delete -f "$raw" ji-host/bin/ji-host
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'exit 1' > "$fixture/ji-host/bin/ji-host"
( cd "$fixture" && tar --mtime='UTC 2026-09-05' --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mode=0755 --append -f "$raw" ji-host/bin/ji-host )
gzip -n "$raw"
test "$(tar -tvzf "$archive" ji-host/runtime/bin/java | tail -n 1 | cut -c1-10)" = '-rwxr-xr-x'
test "$(tar -tvzf "$archive" ji-host/bin/ji-host | tail -n 1 | cut -c1-10)" = '-rwxr-xr-x'
test "$(tar -tzf "$archive" ji-host/bin/ji-host | wc -l)" = 1
sha256sum "$archive"
rm -rf "$fixture"
